result:
All 617 tests pass, and nothing existing was broken. The implementation is complete:

- `src/schemas/project.ts`: added `cloneProjectSchema` / `CloneProjectInput`.
- `src/server/services/project-service.ts`: added `cloneProject`, gated by `project:read` on the source, `project:create` on the org, source-must-be-live, and the plan's project/issue quotas (checked as one batch before anything is written). It creates the new project, optionally copies live issues (resetting status/assignee/parent/timestamps, renumbering from 1, keeping labels), indexes the new project/issues directly, bumps usage counters directly, and emits a single `project.cloned` event — since it never emits `project.created`/`issue.created`.
- `src/server/repositories/project-repository.ts`: added `insertClonedProject` (copies description/visibility/color/lead from source; caller-chosen name/slug/key; starts active with no dates).
- `src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`: added `copyLiveIssuesForClone` (comments/attachments never copied).
- `src/types/event.ts`: added `project.cloned` to `TaskflowEventMap`.
- `src/types/activity.ts` + `src/schemas/activity.ts`: added `project.cloned` audit action.
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts`: records the audit row with `{ sourceProjectId, issuesCopied }` metadata.
- `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts`: added the missing label (required by the exhaustive `Record<ActivityAction, string>` type).
